nodes.title: Measures
nodes.blurb: Time, money, length, mass and capacity — the measurement strand early primary expects before ratio work.

nodes.title: First numbers
nodes.blurb: Bonds, tables, and the four operations, drilled until a later course can assume them. Then place value and a first fraction.

nodes.title: Pre-algebra
nodes.blurb: The whole number strand, ratio, and the first letters. This is the KS3 opening, before quadratics.

nodes.title: Geometry
nodes.blurb: Angles, polygons, circles, area and volume, Pythagoras, similarity, then a coordinate grid.

nodes.title: Algebra
nodes.blurb: Indices through quadratics, simultaneous equations, sequences, and the first logarithms.

nodes.title: Trigonometry
nodes.blurb: Right-angled triangles first, then the unit circle, identities, and equations.

nodes.title: Higher certificate
nodes.blurb: One school road, KS3 through the Higher course, in a single tree. Use it whole, or after the split courses.

nodes.title: Precalculus
nodes.blurb: Conics, parametric and polar form, and the last algebra a calculus course assumes. Companion to Functions.

nodes.title: Functions
nodes.blurb: The bridge. Notation, transformations, then the families a diploma or a calculus course expects.

nodes.title: Analysis SL
nodes.blurb: The standard-level half of Analysis and approaches. Same order as the HL tree, with the HL-only topics left out.

nodes.title: Analysis HL
nodes.blurb: The diploma this room was built around. Five units, HL topics marked, a worked example and five questions on each.

nodes.title: Applications
nodes.blurb: Models, measure, data, and a lighter calculus. The Applications and interpretation path, not the proof path.

nodes.title: Calculus
nodes.blurb: Rate of change, then area. The order of Thompson and the skills workbook, using the diploma calculus as the spine.

nodes.title: Statistics
nodes.blurb: From a mean and a tree diagram to the binomial, the normal, and Bayes.

nodes.title: Linear algebra
nodes.blurb: Vectors, then matrices: a determinant, a matrix times a vector, and a linear system.

nodes.title: Mechanics
nodes.blurb: Constant acceleration, forces, and projectiles — the applied half of A-level Maths / first-year physics maths.

nodes.title: The infinite
nodes.blurb: Finite sums, then sums that do not stop. Euler’s order: geometric series, then the exponential series.

nodes.title: Topology
nodes.blurb: A first foothold, not the whole graduate course: finite sets, subsets, unions, and which numbers sit in an interval.

nodes.title: A partial sum of powers of one half
A confidence interval for a mean
A hypothesis test for a proportion
Indices & surds
nodes.blurb: Powers, roots, and rationalising a denominator.
nodes.hlLink: You need this before logs, binomial expansions, and exact trig values.

nodes.title: Expand, factor, rearrange
nodes.blurb: The algebra you are expected to do without thinking.
nodes.hlLink: Every HL paper hides marks inside clean factorising.

nodes.title: Lines & equations
nodes.hlLink: Tangents, normals, and simultaneous conditions all start here.

nodes.title: Quadratics
nodes.hlLink: HL functions live on vertex form, equal roots, and intersections.

nodes.title: Exponents & logs
nodes.blurb: The log laws before the HL questions get clever.
nodes.hlLink: Inverse of an exponential, and half of the algebra paper, sits on this.

nodes.title: Function notation
nodes.blurb: Evaluate, compose, invert a linear, and name a domain.
nodes.hlLink: Paper 1 opens on $fcirc g$ and $f^{-1}$ more often than people expect.

nodes.title: Right-triangle trig
nodes.hlLink: HL identities are unpleasant if $sin 60^{circ}$ is not instant.

nodes.title: Data & chance
nodes.blurb: Mean, median, and the first probability rules.
nodes.hlLink: Combined events and binomial probability assume these without a reminder.

nodes.title: linear · 4
nodes.blurb: The line through $(1,2)$ and $(3,8)$ has equation $y=mx+c$. Find $m$.

nodes.title: quadratics · 5
nodes.blurb: Solve $x^{2}=12$, leaving the answer in surd form.

nodes.title: functions · 5
nodes.blurb: For which value of $x$ is $f(x)=\dfrac{1}{x-2}$ undefined?

nodes.title: trig · 1
nodes.blurb: A right triangle has opposite side $3$ and adjacent side $4$. Find $\sin\theta$ for that acute angle.

nodes.title: trig · 2
nodes.blurb: Write down the exact value of $\cos 60^{\circ}$.

nodes.title: trig · 3
nodes.blurb: Write down the exact value of $\sin 45^{\circ}$.

nodes.title: trig · 5
nodes.blurb: Write down the exact value of $\tan 30^{\circ}$.

nodes.title: chance · 2
nodes.blurb: A fair six-sided die is rolled. Find the probability of an even number.

nodes.title: chance · 4
nodes.blurb: Two fair coins are flipped. Find the probability of two heads.
